payload.content:
name: techvault-observability-core
description: 'Curated TechVault observability-core slice. Declares only the OTEL core
  observability stack to prove the backend realizes the smallest bounded startup surface
  from declared SDL content.

  '
nodes:
  security-net:
    type: switch
    description: SOC and security tooling network.
  aptl-otel-collector:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 4317
      protocol: tcp
      name: otlp-grpc
    - port: 4318
      protocol: tcp
      name: otlp-http
  aptl-tempo:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 3200
      protocol: tcp
      name: tempo-http
  aptl-grafana-otel:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services:
    - port: 3000
      protocol: tcp
      name: grafana
infrastructure:
  security-net:
    properties:
      cidr: 172.20.0.0/24
      gateway: 172.20.0.1
      internal: false
  aptl-otel-collector:
    links:
    - security-net
  aptl-tempo:
    links:
    - security-net
  aptl-grafana-otel:
    links:
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - aptl-tempo
